## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated formatting or generated artifacts.
- [ ] New behavior has regression tests, including important invalid and boundary inputs.
- [ ] Existing behavior and compatibility were verified at a scope proportional to the risk.
- [ ] User-facing behavior, formats, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] The changelog was updated for a user-visible change, or the reason it is unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Benchmark claims include a reproducible command and do not generalize beyond measured evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, restricted datasets, build outputs, or license-incompatible material are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the repository's MIT License.
- [ ] Material automated assistance is disclosed in this pull request when applicable.
